name: rejection.cause
description: Project Get a Job: classify why an application or interview did not advance, from the rejection email plus Mike's post-interview notes. Turns 'I need to interview better' into a counted claim per cause.

cause.instructions: Most likely primary reason this did not advance

criteria.comp_mismatch: Compensation expectations above the role's band
criteria.sold_consulting: Candidate came across as a consultant/founder pitching services rather than a hire
criteria.seniority_mismatch: Seen as over- or under-levelled for the seat
criteria.technical_depth: Interviewer wanted deeper hands-on technical proof than was given
criteria.domain_gap: Missing industry or functional domain the team needed
criteria.internal_or_other_candidate: Role filled internally or by a candidate already ahead in process
criteria.no_signal: Generic rejection with nothing to infer

explicit_reason_given.instructions: The employer's message states an actual reason rather than boilerplate

stage_reached.instructions: Furthest stage evidenced in the text

criteria.hiring_manager: Spoke to the hiring manager or team
criteria.final: Reached a final round or offer stage

rules.reason: the trainable pattern -- add to drill queue
check whether the role was ever in band; adjust job.fit if it was not

notes: Weekly rollup: count by cause. That count is the ProofPacket behind any 'this is why' claim.
